Titles.eng: Detective Conan: The Bride of Halloween
Titles.jpn: 名探偵コナン ハロウィンの花嫁

Summaries.eng: Conan and company are attending a wedding ceremony, with none other than Detective Sato as the beautiful bride. But when an assailant attempts to disrupt the ceremony, Detective Takagi puts his life on the line! Thankfully Takagi was uninjured, but the ordeal reminds Sato of Jinpei Matsuda, a former colleague who had been killed in a serial bombing case three years prior. Elsewhere, Rei Furuya a.k.a. Toru Amuro is tasked to hunt down a serial bomber but something doesn’t seem right...  As the mysterious threat of “Plamya” looms over the bustling city of Shibuya, is there anything Conan can do to prevent a tragedy?

Aliases: Case Closed: The Bride of Halloween
Detective Conan Movie 25: The Bride of Halloween
